characters.name: Amy
characters.clothing: Amy wears a dark brown rough‑spun linen tunic that reaches her mid-thigh and shows slight fraying at the cuffs, paired with a scuffed leather apron over it in which she keeps tools for pouring ale. Below, she dons tan woolen breeches tucked into sturdy black leather boots. A simple brown belt cinches her waist, holding small pouches for coins and kitchen utensils. Her hair is tied back in a loose knot to keep it out of the way while she works
